# From local strength to global leadership: Euromoney recognises Santander CIB with eight outstanding Transaction Banking awards

- Email
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=https%3A//www.santandercib.com/news-insights/news/local-strength-global-leadership-euromoney-recognises-santander-cib-eight)
- [Twitter](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=From%20local%20strength%20to%20global%20leadership%3A%20Euromoney%20recognises%20Santander%20CIB%20with%20eight%20outstanding%20Transaction%20Banking%20awards&url=https%3A//www.santandercib.com/news-insights/news/local-strength-global-leadership-euromoney-recognises-santander-cib-eight)


Santander CIB has received **eight accolades at the 2026 Euromoney Transaction Banking Awards** , extending the recognition achieved in 2025 and reflecting the continued development of its global Transaction Banking franchise.


At the global level, Santander CIB was named **World’s Best Trade Finance Bank** , while in Latin America it received the title of **Best Transaction Bank** . The recognition extends across individual markets in Argentina, Brazil, Spain, US, Uruguay and Chile, including recognition for Cash Management across key markets.


The breadth of the 2026 awards is significant. Recognition at global, regional and country level reflects a model designed to combine international capabilities with deep knowledge of the markets in which clients operate.
It also builds on continued progress in Santander CIB’s trade and export finance franchise. Santander ended 2025 as the world’s leading export finance bank for the fourth consecutive year, with USD 18.2 billion in transactions and a 14.5% global market share, while also ranking first in Europe and Latin America.


The latest Transaction Banking awards form part of a wider year of recognition for Santander CIB, alongside Euromoney accolades across Investment Banking, FX and Markets.


For Santander CIB, this recognition is ultimately a reflection of something broader: the ability to connect expertise across products, sectors and geographies to address increasingly complex client needs.


The awards may mark individual achievements. **The progression behind them tells a bigger story.**


Discover our awards here:[Awards & Recognitions](https://www.santandercib.com/about-us/awards-recognitions)
